Its one section offers a kind-8 'use' record in state 1 (a cylinder of r 553.1 and 632.1 high centred 158 under the symbol, cone 95 degrees about its facing): Interact inside it starts transition 1 -> 0 (trigger 20, kind 8), whose state event runs the script's vt 54 -> vt 55 -> dispatcher 8997 vt 65, which counts the four symbols [O bytecode: vt 63-66 set a flag each, vt 62 stops eitr fall 8998 (vt 56) for the 60 s of its clock once all four are set]. One symbol alone leaves the fall running.
